items.title: Abe Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: But mostly he’d call me and say I need some clarinet stuff for this guy.

ctx.x: Joel, right. So whenever he did something, the clarinet would be playing a little something. So that’s usually, in the old days — the old days, 20 or 30 years back, usually they would assign an instrument to a character. Al Newman, all the big composers would do that. In the big pictures they would have a trumpet above the orchestra signifying a big field with a lot of dead bodies — you know. That would be his theme for that—
